description: This file declares the ServerManagerModuleService class and its factory, which are part of the IPC layer for managing server modules in the Rialto project. It defines interfaces for setting configuration, state, log levels, and ping operations, and references external session management and IPC server components.

classes.name: ServerManagerModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of ServerManagerModuleService, implementing the IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory interface.

classes.name: ServerManagerModuleService
classes.description: Implementation of the ServerManagerModule service, providing methods to set configuration, state, log levels, and handle ping requests.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a ServerManagerModule instance, given a session server manager.

methods.name: ServerManagerModuleService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with a session server manager reference.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Handles setting configuration via protobuf request and response objects.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Handles setting the server state via protobuf request and response objects.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Handles setting log levels via protobuf request and response objects.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Handles a ping request to check server responsiveness.
